fix.value: Signed by the Governor on 22 Jun 2026 and effective 1 Jan 2027. The Senate passed Substitute A as amended on 21 May 2026 and the House passed it in concurrence on 8 Jun 2026; the House companion bill is H 7350. Enacted alongside two Rhode Island health-care AI laws of June 2026: S 2570 (notification when AI documents clinical visits) and S 2197 (Oversight of Artificial Intelligence Technology in Mental Health Care Act, barring AI from making independent therapeutic decisions), which are not recorded separately.
